procedure.guidance: The issue may involve an input of an unexpected type. Identify the accepted types from the documentation and existing callers; normalise inputs once at the public entry point (convert, or raise TypeError with a clear message) using isinstance checks; avoid sprinkling type checks through internal helpers; preserve existing accepted types; test each accepted and one rejected type.
